passive.name: Inherent Glamour
passive.description: Neeko can look like an ally champion or as other units on the map. Receiving immobilizing crowd control, casting damaging spells, damaging enemy towers as a non-champion, or your disguise taking damage equal to its healthbar breaks the disguise.

spells.name: Blooming Burst
spells.description: Neeko throws a seed dealing magic damage. The seed blooms again on hitting champions or killing units.
spells.tooltip: Neeko throws a seed that blooms to deal <magicDamage>{{ explosiondamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>. If it kills a unit or hits a champion or large monster, it will bloom again, dealing <magicDamage>{{ seconddamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>. Max 2 extra blooms.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Shapesplitter
spells.description: Neeko passively deals bonus magic damage every third attack, briefly increasing her move speed. Neeko can activate to send a clone in a direction and recast to change the direction of the clone.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Every 3rd Attack deals an additional {{ passivebonusdamagecalc }} bonus magic damage and increases Neeko's Move Speed by {{ passivehaste }}% for {{ passivehasteduration }} second.

Active: Neeko becomes invisible for {{ stealthduration }} seconds and projects a clone that lasts {{ cloneduration }} seconds. Neeko and the clone gain {{ haste }}% Move Speed for {{ hasteduration }} seconds.

The clone can be controlled using the Move Pet Click hotkey or by Recasting this Ability.
The clone mirrors her spellcasts, emotes, and recall.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Tangle-Barbs
spells.description: Neeko slings a tangle that damages and roots everything it passes through. If the tangle kills an enemy or passes through a champion, it becomes larger, faster, and roots for longer.
spells.tooltip:
Neeko slings a tangle that deals {{ basedamage }} magic damage and Roots for {{ minrootduration }} seconds.

The tangle becomes empowered after hitting an enemy, growing larger, moving faster, and Rooting for {{ maxrootduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Pop Blossom
spells.description: After a short preparation, Neeko leaps into the air, knocking up all nearby enemies. Upon landing, nearby enemies are damaged and stunned. The preparation is hidden if Neeko is disguised.
spells.tooltip:
After a delay Neeko leaps into the air, Knocking Up all nearby enemies for {{ delayuntilexplosion }} seconds. She then crashes down, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to all nearby enemies and Stunning them for {{ stunduration }} seconds.

This Ability can be prepared in secret if Neeko is disguised. {{ delaybeforepassiveremoval }} seconds after casting this ability Neeko breaks her disguise.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

variants.name: Inherent Glamour
effects: Innate: Neeko has a collection of disguises to take on the appearance of allied champions. She can choose a new champion to switch her disguise or select herself to deactivate her disguise, placing Inherent Glamour on a 0.5-second cooldown. Taking damage from a champion or turret puts Inherent Glamour on a 2-second cooldown.

Standing by the nearest visible allied or neutral non-champion non-structure unit while not disguised will gather its Sho'Ma over 2 seconds, adding its disguise to the collection. Activating this disguise places Inherent Glamour on a 1-second cooldown. Neeko can collect only one Sho'Ma, but can discard or consume it. She can store Sho'Ma from the following units, so long as they are targetable:

Non-epic monsters
 Minions
 Traps
 Wards
 Pets
Jungle plants

While disguised, Neeko can use basic attacks while keeping her form. Her disguise breaks if she:

uses a damaging ability, summoner spell, or item active
is immobilized
takes damage lethal to the disguised form
is in the enemy spawn platform
begins a channel other than Recall and Empowered Recall
deals damage to a structure with a non-champion disguise form
 dies
Inherent Glamour's disguise is not deactivated from Pop Blossom until after 0.5 seconds of its cast. Neeko cannot activate Inherent Glamour while she is unable to cast abilities.

variants.name: Shapesplitter
effects: The clone lasts for 3 seconds, starts running a fixed distance in the target direction, and is untargetable to allies and for the first 0.5 seconds of its lifespan to enemies. Once the clone takes damage, it will disappear prematurely, after 0.5 seconds.Additionally, the clone stops ongoing movement in order to play the casting animations for Blooming Burst and Tangle-Barbs as well as Pop Blossom's visual effects whenever Neeko casts them. The clone will also play the animation of her next emote or Recall for a set duration that overrides its original duration and will not take any other orders while doing so.
Recast: Neeko sends her clone to the target location if it is not playing an emote or Recall animation.

variants.name: Pop Blossom
effects: Active: Neeko winds up spiritual essence over 1.25 seconds and highlights an area around herself, which is visible to enemies unless she is disguised. If Neeko is in a disguise, it will break after 0.5 seconds into the duration.
After winding up, the cast time begins and Neeko leaps upward, knocking up nearby enemies for 0.6 seconds.

changes.title: W - Shapeshifter
changes.text: Slightly-Less-Tricksy-Neekoses : Cooldown now starts on clone expiration, instead of on cast

changes.title: W - Shapeshifter
changes.text: Fun Eliminated : Neeko can no longer use Ctrl+5, which plays the joke expression for clone only. Neeko can still joke, dance, recall, to make their clone initiate said actions.

changes.title: R - Pop Blossom
changes.text: Channel Disguised Duration : Neeko is disguised for the entire 1.25 second cast time ⇒ Neeko is disguised for the first 0.5 seconds of the cast, and is then revealed for the remaining 0.75 seconds

changes.title: Passive - Inherent Glamour
changes.text: Neeko Get Sho'Ma! : When Neeko is near a non-epic monster, minion, trap, ward, or plant for two seconds she stores their Sho'Ma. Neeko can click on her bar to become that unit. Click on Neeko's face to return to Neeko. Click on the little “X” to clear out Neeko's current Sho'Ma. Only one unit can be stored at a time.

changes.title: Passive - Inherent Glamour
changes.text: Neeko Disguise is Durable! : Disguise no longer breaks on taking damage, only when the disguised self would have died or when you are crowd controlled.

changes.title: Passive - Inherent Glamour
changes.text: removed Neeko for Speedo : Neeko no longer inherits base attack speed/move speed from disguised target if that stat is higher than hers.

changes.title: Q - Blooming Burst
changes.text: Area of Effect Size : 225 ⇒ 250 (Note: Max range E snares should always be hittable with Q now)

changes.title: Q - Blooming Burst
changes.text: new Jungle Tomato : Q now deals 30/40/50/60/70 bonus damage to monsters

changes.title: Q - Blooming Burst
changes.text: new Better Blooms : Casting Q beyond its maximum range will now cast the ability at maximum range instead of having Neeko walk into position to throw it.

changes.title: W - Shapesplitter
changes.text: new Neeko Move Neeko : After casting Neeko can reactivate to send the clone to a new location

changes.title: W - Shapesplitter
changes.text: new Neeko Funny! : Clone now plays animations and sounds of Q/E/Dance/Joke/Taunt/Recall/Laugh and survives for their duration

changes.title: W - Shapesplitter
changes.text: Neeko Jungle! : Empowered Attacks deal 50 bonus damage to monsters

changes.title: W - Shapesplitter
changes.text: Neeko is Become One : Neeko's clone spawns 100 units in front of her ⇒ Neeko's clone spawns directly on top of her

changes.title: R - Pop Blossom
changes.text: Adjusted Ultimate : After channeling for 1.25 seconds, Neeko jumps into the air, knocking up all nearby enemies for 0.6 seconds. Neeko then crashes to the ground with all knocked up enemies, dealing magic damage to them and stunning them for 0.75 seconds.

changes.title: R - Pop Blossom
changes.text: removed Neeko Need No Shield! : Neeko no longer gains a shield when channeling her R

changes.title: QoL Changes
changes.text: NEEKO'S REAL SHO'MA: When playing as Neeko, your center HUD (i.e. the buff icons above your skills) will now always display your actual buffs, rather than the buffs of the ally you are disguised as if using

changes.title: QoL Changes
changes.text: NEEKO'S REAL SHO'MA When playing as Neeko, your center HUD (i.e. the buff icons above your skills) will now always display your actual buffs, rather than the buffs of the ally you are disguised as if using Passive - Inherent Glamour. Enemies who click on you will still see the buffs of the ally you are disguised as in the target UI at the top of their screen.

changes.title: E - Tangle Barbs
changes.text: DAMAGE RATIO: 0.4 ability power ⇒ 0.6 ability power

changes.title: W - Shapesplitter
changes.text: CLONE AND HASTE DURATION: 2 seconds ⇒ 3 seconds (stealth duration still 0.5 seconds)

changes.title: W - Shapesplitter
changes.text: PATHING: Neeko's clone now travels in the target direction until it runs into terrain, rather than pathing to the target location

changes.title: W - Shapesplitter
changes.text: BUGFIX: Shapesplitter's passive once again works on turrets

changes.title: R - Pop Blossom
changes.text: removed SLOW: removed SLOW Enemies in Pop Blossom's radius are no longer slowed by 40%

changes.title: R - Pop Blossom
changes.text: TOOLTIP FIX: Tooltip now indicates the ability power ratio on Pop Blossom's shield (actual scaling unchanged)
